title: ARTPARK Dashboard — ARTPARK @IISc - Leading AI & Robotics startup incubation
text:
Startups | Facilities

ARTPARK (AI & Robotics Technology Park), created by IISc, builds deep-tech innovations and startups in robotics, AI, and autonomous systems.

Our IP-differentiated portfolio includes core components (e.g., robotics components, scientific foundation models) and complex products (e.g., large hybrid VTOL drones, satellite communications), attracting international and strategic investors.

With deep support, a 3-acre robotics & AI facility, team building, and customer collaborations to go from concepts to prototypes to product-market fit, at ARTPARK, innovators become founders.

Support from the Department of Science & Technology’s NMICPS, Government of Karnataka, and Ministry of Heavy Industries has been critical to our success.

We are now building a 9-acre BRAINZ (Bengaluru Robotics & AI Innovation Zone) campus (thanks to the Government of Karnataka) and a Rs. 1,000 Cr fund.

We look forward to partnering with investors and corporate R&D leaders to catapult India’s robotics and AI innovators into a higher orbit.
